title: Uneven drops
prompt: Two resistors in series on 12 V should each drop 6 V. R1 drops 4 V and R2 drops 8 V.
explanation: With the same current, the bigger drop belongs to the bigger resistance. R2 has the larger value.

lines: The same current flows through both (series)
A bigger drop means a bigger resistance: V = I x R
R2 drops more, so R2 has the smaller resistance
The drops still add to 12 V, so nothing is open
